title: Ordered list of intervals
statement: A list of natural-number pairs is in order below $T$ if it is empty, if its sole pair $(a,n)$ satisfies $a+n\le T$, or, when it has at least two pairs, each pair's starting point plus length is at most the next pair's starting point and this condition holds recursively for the remaining list.
